supported_scope: Ordinary non-internal-ACK processing of already decoded bunch objects: reliable ordering/queue, partial assembly, channel opening/closing and skip-ACK separation.
implementation_qualifications: Semantic input flag masks are native object flags, not a recovered on-wire header.
GUID exports require an upstream decoder to explicitly report processing success.
Connection-specific special open paths and both-initial-and-final inputs are unimplemented.
Assembly byte limits and fail-stop behavior for current-input errors are local resource/error policies.
Queued skip-ACK/errors are separate from the current packet; native queue drain does not propagate those flags back.
